newsitem.title: USA: Inhale Therapeutic hails Phase I trial.
newsitem.headline: Inhale Therapeutic hails Phase I trial.

text.p: Inhale Therapeutic Systems said Monday that it had successfully completed a Phase I clinical trial using Inhale's pulmonary delivery system to administer an aerosolized form of a drug to treat osteoporosis.

The company said the single-dose bioavailability study compared subcutaneous injection of the drug with pulmonary delivery using the Inhale aerosolized delivery system in 18 fasted, normal volunteers.
The company said the results indicated that the drug was systemically absorbed when delivered with Inhale's system.
Inhale said it now has four drugs in human clinical trials using its delivery system.

The company said the completion of this Phase I trial provides further confirmation of the potential of its pulmonary system to deliver a wide range of peptides and proteins currently delivered by injection.
